test.summary: SPM - OKR - Inline editing of OKR type field
test.description:
This test verifies inline editing of the *OKR Type field* in both *Overview* and *Side Panel*.


* Editing the OKR Type field in *Overview*
* Editing OKR Type field in *Side Panel*
* Removing selected value
* Data consistency between Overview and Side Panel

steps.action: Open OKR Overview of boxName and create Objective and Key-result
steps.data: boxName: TC-6086 SPM - OKR - Inline editing of OKR type field
steps.result: Objective and Key-result are created and visible in OKR overview

steps.action: Hover over the Objective and Key-result OKR type fields
steps.result:
The row is highlighted (grey background) when the user hovers over it
+ button and tooltip "Add OKR type" is displayed

steps.action: Navigate to Objective OKR type field and click + Add
steps.result: Dropdown is displayed with lists of OKR types - Company, Personal, Team
OKR type Personal is displayed in field for Objective

steps.action: Click on the grey area of the Objective row
steps.result: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Objective. The Objective OKR type is consistent with the value in Overview

steps.action: In Side Panel select Type field
steps.result: Dropdown is displayed with lists of OKR types - Company, Personal, Team
OKR type is changed to Company.

steps.action: Navigate to Overview → Key-result OKR type field and click + Add
steps.result: Dropdown is displayed with lists of OKR types - Company, Personal, Team
OKR type "Team" is displayed  for Key-result

steps.action: Click on the grey area of the Key-result row
steps.result: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Key-result. The Key-result OKR type is consistent with the value in Overview

steps.action: In Side Panel select Type field and click Clear X button
steps.result: OKR type field value disappear from Side panel and Overview for Key-result

rag.text:
Test: TC-6086 — SPM - OKR - Inline editing of OKR type field
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/SPM/OKR/TS-512 OKR - OKR module
Labels: spm-mikolaj-tc

Description:
This test verifies inline editing of the *OKR Type field* in both *Overview* and *Side Panel*.


* Editing the OKR Type field in *Overview*
* Editing OKR Type field in *Side Panel*
* Removing selected value
* Data consistency between Overview and Side Panel

Steps:
1. Open OKR Overview of boxName and create Objective and Key-result
   Data: boxName: TC-6086 SPM - OKR - Inline editing of OKR type field
   Expected: Objective and Key-result are created and visible in OKR overview
2. Hover over the Objective and Key-result OKR type fields
   Expected: The row is highlighted (grey background) when the user hovers over it
+ button and tooltip "Add OKR type" is displayed
3. Navigate to Objective OKR type field and click + Add
   Expected: Dropdown is displayed with lists of OKR types - Company, Personal, Team
4. Select Personal
   Expected: OKR type Personal is displayed in field for Objective
5. Click on the grey area of the Objective row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Objective. The Objective OKR type is consistent with the value in Overview
6. In Side Panel select Type field
   Expected: Dropdown is displayed with lists of OKR types - Company, Personal, Team
7. Select Company
   Expected: OKR type is changed to Company.
8. Navigate to Overview → Key-result OKR type field and click + Add
   Expected: Dropdown is displayed with lists of OKR types - Company, Personal, Team
9. Select Team
   Expected: OKR type "Team" is displayed  for Key-result
10. Click on the grey area of the Key-result row
   Expected: Side panel is opened on the right side and displays details of the selected Key-result. The Key-result OKR type is consistent with the value in Overview
11. In Side Panel select Type field and click Clear X button
   Expected: OKR type field value disappear from Side panel and Overview for Key-result
